name: Cub
expectations: Long horizontal trunk and smaller offset head
Unequal eye clusters and dark flank marking

name: Cub: body-ratio
expectations: Authored trunk proportions alter descendant trunk proportions; inherited genes stay fixed. Pixel area is recorded, not assumed conserved after rasterization.

name: Cub: body-bend
expectations: Authored trunk curvature influences descendant centerline or material contour, without rerolling unrelated genes.

name: Cub: attachment-length
expectations: Longer authored tail has a measurable corresponding descendant effect while retaining its source identity and root.

name: Cub: face-spacing
expectations: Wider authored eye spacing remains distinguishable on descendant hosts; unrelated anatomy does not reroll.

name: Cub: palette-control
expectations: Recoloring changes pigments but not anatomy, inherited genes, or structural descriptors.

name: Cub: ordering-control
expectations: Source array ordering with unchanged IDs, depths and pixels must not change output or genes.
